FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoCampaignsText: UTM builder and naming conventions for your team, so that campaigns arrive in Matomo cleanly.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoCampaignsInstallText: The free plugin Feinwerk Campaign Manager builds clean campaign links right in Matomo and shows visits and conversions per campaign.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoCampaignsOpenText: Feinwerk Campaign Manager is installed: create campaign links and see visits and conversions per campaign.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoHostingText: Feinwerk runs your Matomo instance in German data centers, with updates, backups and monitoring, and the move is included.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoCapiText: Feinwerk Conversions API sends orders and goals from Matomo server-side to Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X and Microsoft Advertising, only with consent and without ad pixels on your website.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoSentinelText: The free plugin Feinwerk Sentinel watches your Matomo data around the clock and alerts you by email, Slack or Teams as soon as goals stop or tracking breaks.

FeinwerkDataExploration.FunnelHelp: Describe the steps of a path through your website, such as a page, an event and a goal, and see how many visits reached each step in this order. Other actions in between are allowed. The funnel is calculated from the raw data of the chosen period, so it needs no setup in advance.

FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoConnectorText: Exclusive Plugins for Matomo by Feinwerk, free, freemium and premium:
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoConnectorLink: Install the Feinwerk Connector from the Matomo Marketplace
FeinwerkDataExploration.PremiumAskSuperUser: Your Matomo super user can install it.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginAuthSamlText: Auth SAML connects Matomo to your identity provider: SAML 2.0 single sign-on, SCIM 2.0 on- and offboarding and site permissions driven by your IdP groups. For Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak and any SAML provider.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginChannelGroupingText: Group hundreds of traffic sources into the marketing channels you actually steer: Organic, Paid, Email, Social or your own.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginConversionsApiText: Conversions API sends your Matomo goals and ecommerce orders server-side to Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X, Microsoft Advertising, ChatGPT Ads and TikTok: with consent per platform, automatic click attribution and close to real time.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginEmailReportsProText: Email Reports Pro turns your Matomo data into designed email reports: key figures with their trend, clear charts and tables that make even multi-level reports readable. You put every report together from building blocks and see in the preview how the email arrives.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginSearchReportText: Search Report imports Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools into native Matomo reports: daily, automatically, with unlimited history beyond Google's 16-month limit.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginSentinelProText: Sentinel Pro adds visit forecasts, public holidays and alarms per channel and conversion rate to the free Sentinel, plus a watchdog that speaks up when Sentinel itself stops.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginTrackingRouterText: Keep every website in its own profile and add a shared profile with continuous sessions: one tracking request, copied on the server to the sites you allow.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginTrackingSpamScoreText: Spots bot traffic by how whole groups of visits behave, shows it per network and blocks it while tracking, server-side.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginVisitJourneyText: A funnel with no presets: Visit Journey shows, for every goal and every order, which steps really came before it: pages, events, other goals and the channel the visit came through, as an interactive flow chart in Matomo.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ConnectorInstallerIntro: With the free Feinwerk Connector you install, update and license Feinwerk plugins right inside Matomo.
